oracleRule: Every expected value is a documented contract; every actual value is a real run of the delivered modules against the in-memory IndexedDB double, with fixed timestamps and no Math.random.

gaps: twoSessionCheckpointBytes is null in the 203 manifest; this report measures the produced file but does not calibrate a hardware capacity.
totalHeapBytes is null; memory is reported as owned byte counters, not as a page heap reading.
The deterministic transcript measures bytes and states, not wall-clock encode/hash cost.
